note: Re-judged 2026-11-27 independently against RFC 5216 Section 2.1.1 (rfc/full/rfc5216.txt). Tagged units (TestEAPTLSMutualAuthHandshakeSucceeds, TestRFC5216PeerSendsItsCertificateWhateverTheRequestNames, TestRFC5216AuthenticatorRefusesAPeerThatSendsNoCertificate) only added ServerIdentity="eap-tls-server" (and serverConfig added AllowedIdentities=["eap-tls-client"]) to satisfy Section 5.3. Positive units still verify the peer sends its configured DER certificate and certificate_verify on the wire after certificate_request (even when the request names another CA) and completes mutual auth; negative units still verify ClientAuth=RequireAndVerifyClientCert with non-nil ClientCAs and that a certless peer flight (empty certificate_list, no certificate_verify) is rejected with a non-verification error, no EAP-Success, and incomplete TLS handshake. Verdict stands: enforced.
